Before the world hurts him, light his way. 🏮 "Loser." "Nobody likes you." "It's your fault." You can't stop every word. But you can prepare him.

Meet Ezra. He's six, and every lesson is a little light for the dark nights ahead:
1️⃣ Not everyone will like you, and that's okay.
2️⃣ Your words can leave scars. 💔
3️⃣ Never hide your mistakes. Hiding keeps you from growing.
4️⃣ Kindness is not weakness, but never let people walk all over you.
5️⃣ Choose your friends carefully.
6️⃣ It's okay to feel angry. Hurting others is never okay.
7️⃣ Never laugh at someone's pain, even as a joke.
8️⃣ You can always start again. One bad day isn't the end. 🌅

12 years later, Ezra is eighteen and far from home. He sees someone sitting alone… and he goes and sits next to him. ❤️ Her lessons went where she couldn't.

Jesus said, "I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life." John 8:12 (ESV) 🙏

So let him remember: you are loved. You are never alone. You're loved as you are. ❤️ And one day, he'll be a light for someone else too.

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
